facts.fact: Deliberation 004/2025 of 14 July 2025 is taken under articles 21 and 73 of law 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 on personal data protection, which shows the law in operation on that date.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The APD met on 14 July 2025 under its president with seven named members, under decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on its composition and operation.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Deliberation 004/2025 (14 July 2025, amended) is taken under articles 21 and 73 of the law and article 41 of decree 2022-13, requires prior APD authorisation for transfers abroad to countries not on its list and lists 105 countries as adequate.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The APD issued deliberation 004/2025 on 14 July 2025 after consulting the foreign affairs, justice and digital transformation ministries, setting the adequacy list and authorisation rule for transfers abroad.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection
